### E&F Currency Merge -- GENERATED FILE, DO NOT EDIT
### Rebuild with tools/regen_ef_currency_merge.py after any E&F or hotfix update.
###
### Source: the bank companies in E&F's own 00_ef_companies.txt, ordered by
### CENTRAL_BANK_COMPANY in the generator.
###
### WHY THIS EXISTS
###
### There is no effect in the game that gives an existing building to a company.
### add_ownership is a field of create_building and nothing else -- all ~1900
### uses in vanilla are inside one, and no ownership effect appears in
### effects_l_english.yml or common/effect_localization/. The only other route
### into company hands is privatisation, which is the AI's call, on its own
### schedule, and which ignores the company monopoly: in the Papal States a
### rival bank company privatised 4 levels away from the monopoly holder.
### That is why the central bank has to be born owned.
###
### State scope. $CB_SIZE$ and $BANK_BLDG_TYPE$ come straight through from
### whichever E&F spawner called it.
###
### $BANK_BLDG_TYPE$ IS PASSED ON PURPOSE, even though every caller sets it to
### building_bank and this could name the building directly. An argument the
### callers pass and the effect does not use is a fatal compile error, not a
### warning, and it takes the whole effect down with it:
###
###   [jomini_script_argument.cpp:182]: Compiling source for failed for unknown
###   arguments: BANK_BLDG_TYPE. At
###   common/scripted_effects/09_introduction_building_lvl.txt:23498
###
### The result was every central bank in the world missing at game start, and
### not one line about it in error.log -- it is in debug.log.
###
### NO `level` FIELD WHERE add_ownership IS PRESENT. The level is the sum of
### the ownership levels; writing both makes the engine throw the whole block
### away at load:
###
###   [jomini_effect.cpp:141]: PostValidate of effect 'create_building'
###   returned false at common/scripted_effects/zz_ef_cm_bank_ownership.txt:982
###
### Vanilla says the same thing by example: 3128 create_building blocks in
### common/history/buildings/ carry add_ownership, and not one of them sets
### level. Only the last-resort branch, which grants no ownership, still does.

zz_ef_cm_create_owned_bank = {
	owner = {
		save_scope_as = zz_ef_cm_bank_owner
	}

	### Already at least this big -- nothing to do. E&F calls its spawners on a
	### pulse and lets create_building expand the bank as gdp_view rises, so this
	### effect runs over and over on a bank that is already the right size.
	###
	### zz_ef_cm_bank_rebuild is how the swap gets asked for. Ownership cannot be
	### moved -- add_ownership exists only inside create_building -- so when a
	### country's historical bank finally shows up years after its central bank
	### was built, the only way to hand it over is to build the thing again. The
	### monthly pass sets the variable; this is what makes it stop skipping.
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_scope_building = {
				is_building_type = $BANK_BLDG_TYPE$
				level >= $CB_SIZE$
			}
			NOT = {
				scope:zz_ef_cm_bank_owner = {
					has_variable = zz_ef_cm_bank_rebuild
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		### THE BANK IS REBUILT, NOT EXPANDED, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE.
		### Expanding an existing building hands the NEW levels to the state --
		### add_ownership only covers levels created together with the building.
		### E&F grows the central bank exactly that way, by calling create_building
		### again with a bigger level, so Finland came out 5 levels company-owned
		### and 5 state-owned, and in the Papal States a rival bank company then
		### privatised 4 of the state's five. Rebuilding is the only way to keep
		### the whole bank in one pair of hands.
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = $BANK_BLDG_TYPE$ }
			remove_building = $BANK_BLDG_TYPE$
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:zz_ef_cm_bank_owner = {
					c:ARG ?= this
					has_company = company_type:company_BancoNacionArgentina
				}
			}
			create_building = {
				building = $BANK_BLDG_TYPE$
				reserves = 1
				add_ownership = {
					company = {
						type    = company_BancoNacionArgentina
						country = scope:zz_ef_cm_bank_owner
						levels  = $CB_SIZE$
					}
				}
			}
		}

			limit = {
